name: mac-parallel-accelerator
description: AtomLane finds reviewable Python parallelism candidates, compiles semantics-preserving atomic plans, and executes proven-safe concurrency on macOS and Windows Preview.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Python refactors and parallel execution
interface.longDescription: AtomLane statically finds reviewable Python parallelism candidates without importing or executing target code, then compiles supported entrypoints into immutable hashed atomic plans. It preserves typed control flow and effects, fails closed on unknown hazards, delegates concurrency to native owners when safer, adapts to macOS or native Windows resources, isolates Windows, WSL, and Docker execution realms, and executes exact verified plans with live progress and honestly labeled time savings.
capabilities: Windows ConPTY and UTF-8 pipe progress
Windows, WSL, and Docker realm isolation
defaultPrompt: Use $accelerate-local-work to run only the concurrency proven safe for this project.
Use $optimize-python-parallelism to review this long-running Python entrypoint for a safe parallel refactor.
Use $accelerate-local-work with live progress and per-run plus cumulative time savings.
